results.headline: Singapore’s MAS Proposes Legislative Changes for Single-Currency Stablecoins
results.summary: Singapore’s Monetary Authority has proposed a dedicated framework requiring licensed stablecoin issuers to maintain full 100% reserve backing in safe, liquid assets, segregate reserves with approved custodians, and offer redemption at par within five business days. Public consultation is underway.
facts: Singapore’s MAS Proposes Legislative Changes for Single-Currency Stablecoins. [observed: MAS today published a consultation paper on proposed legislative amendments to t | https://www.mas.gov.sg/news/media-releases/2026/mas-consults-on-legislative-amendments-to-implement-stablecoin-regulatory-framework]
inferences: The proposal aims to enhance the stability and trust in stablecoins.
The requirement for 100% reserve backing suggests a move towards stricter regulation.
do_not_say: The proposal will definitely lead to increased adoption of stablecoins in Singapore.
All stablecoin issuers in Singapore are currently unregulated.

Do not present as new: Singapore’s Monetary Authority has proposed a dedicated framework requiring licensed stablecoin issuers to offer redemption at par within five business days. (event dated 2023-08-15)
